mentions.name: Trias/Ternii Lapilli game investigation
mentions.description: This project investigates the ancient board game Trias/Ternii Lapilli, a game similar to tic-tac-toe, using mathematics to determine whether it can be solved. The findings and approach are documented in a blog write-up, and the work doubles as an opportunity to learn new areas of maths.
